44350070.name: 2C-T-4
44350070.description: 2C-T-4, also known as 4-isopropylthio-2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and 2C families.

46226294.name: CFMB (drug)
46226294.description: CFMB is an experimental drug which acts as a reasonably potent and selective agonist for the free fatty acid receptor FFAR2 with only weak activity at the closely related FFAR3 receptor.

51039094.name: Tucatinib
51039094.description: Tucatinib, sold under the brand name Tukysa, is an anticancer medication used for the treatment of HER2-positive breast cancer.

57522038.name: TUG-891
57522038.description: TUG-891 is an experimental drug which acts as a potent and selective agonist for the free fatty acid receptor FFAR4 .

71271414.name: MK-8189
71271414.description: MK-8189 is a selective phosphodiesterase 10A inhibitor being developed for schizophrenia. It is developed by Merck in collaboration with Royalty Pharma.

71308278.name: Tetrafucol A
71308278.description: Tetrafucol A is a fucol-type phlorotannin found in the brown algae Ascophyllum nodosum, Analipus japonicus and Scytothamnus australis.

71657974.name: Mallotojaponin B
71657974.description: Mallotojaponin B is a dimeric phloroglucinol found in Mallotus oppositifolius.

71721462.name: Α-Pyrrolidinopentiothiophenone
71721462.description: α-Pyrrolidinopentiothiophenone is a synthetic stimulant of the cathinone and thiopropamine families that has been sold online as a designer drug.

72710774.name: 5F-PB-22
72710774.description: 5F-PB-22 (5F-QUPIC or Quinolin-8-yl 1-fluoroPentyl-1H-Indole-3-8-Carboxylate) is a designer drug which acts as a cannabinoid agonist.

76960246.name: Iron polymaltose
76960246.description: Iron -hydroxide polymaltose complex is a medication used to treat iron deficiency / iron deficiency anemia and belongs to the group of oral iron preparations.

90479350.name: Disodium octaborate
90479350.description: Disodium octaborate is a borate of sodium, a chemical compound of sodium, boron, and oxygen — a salt with elemental formula Na2B8O13 or 2[B8O13]2−, also written as Na2O·4B2O3.

101670390.name: Roburin A
101670390.description: Roburin A is a tannin found in oak wood (Quercus robur and Quercus petraea or Quercus alba) or oak cork .

101982710.name: Testosterone enantate benzilic acid hydrazone
101982710.description: Testosterone enantate benzilic acid hydrazone , or testosterone 17β-enantate 3-benzilic acid hydrazone, is a synthetic, injected androgen/anabolic steroid and an androgen ester – specifically, the...

117951478.name: BMS-202
117951478.description: BMS-202 is a small-molecule drug PD-L1 inhibitor developed by Bristol-Myers Squibb which displays significant anti-tumor activity against glioblastoma cells.

121410806.name: Giredestrant
121410806.description: Giredestrant (also known as GDC-9545, RG6171, or RO7197597) is an investigational oral selective estrogen receptor degrader developed by Genentech, a member of the Roche Group, for the treatment of...

129318262.name: Mexedrone
129318262.description: Mexedrone is a stimulant and an entactogen drug of the cathinone class that has been sold online as a designer drug. It is the alpha-methoxy derivative of Mephedrone.

129714166.name: Lysergic acid dipropylamide
129714166.description: Lysergic acid dipropylamide , also known as N,N-dipropyllysergamide , is a psychedelic drug of the lysergamide family related to lysergic acid diethylamide .

129852278.name: Base J
129852278.description: β-D-Glucopyranosyloxymethyluracil or base J is a hypermodified nucleobase found in the DNA of kinetoplastids including the human pathogenic trypanosomes.

135409398.name: Spinochrome E
135409398.description: Spinochrome E (also called 2,3,5,6,7,8-hexahydroxy-1,4-naphthalenedione or hexahydroxynaphthoquinone) is a polyhydroxylated 1,4-naphthoquinone pigment found in sea urchin shell , spine, gonads...

135491830.name: Sethoxydim
135491830.description: Sethoxydim is a postemergent herbicide for control of grass weeds in a wide variety of horticultural crops.

137402358.name: Selnoflast
137402358.description: Selnoflast (development codes RO7486967, RG-6418, IZD334) is an experimental small-molecule drug developed by Hoffmann-La Roche for the treatment of neuroinflammatory conditions.

146342518.name: Clovibactin
146342518.description: Clovibactin is an experimental antibiotic isolated from an uncultured soil Gram-negative β-proteobacterium Eleftheria terrae ssp. carolina, which is one of many soil bacteria.

153289974.name: Suraxavir marboxil
153289974.description: Suraxavir marboxil is an investigational new drug that is being evaluated by Jiangxi Qingfeng Pharmaceutical for the treatment of influenza virus infection.

157010678.name: Deschloroclotizolam
157010678.description: Deschloroclotizolam is a thienotriazolodiazepine derivative which has been sold as a designer drug, first being identified in Sweden in 2021.

165360246.name: Iridium(III) sulfide
165360246.description: Iridium sulfide is the inorganic compound with the formula Ir2S3.

168947062.name: 5-MeO-NsBT
168947062.description: 5-MeO-NsBT, also known as 5-methoxy-N-sec-butyltryptamine, is a psychoactive drug of the tryptamine and 5-methoxytryptamine families.

172866806.name: 2CE-5iPrO
172866806.description: 2CE-5iPrO, also known as 5-iPrO-2C-E or as 2-methoxy-5-isopropoxy-4-ethylphenethylamine, is a psychedelic substituted phenethylamine derivative related to 2C-E, but with the 5-methoxy group extended...

172872054.name: 10-Hydroxy-HHCP
172872054.description: 10-Hydroxy-HHCP is a semi-synthetic cannabinoid which has been sold as a designer drug, first identified in Germany in December 2024.

174880502.name: CF3-Etomidate
174880502.description: CF3-Etomidate is an anesthetic drug related to etomidate, which has been sold as a designer drug as an active ingredient in e-cigarette liquids marketed under names such as space oil or kpods.

177841654.name: Tungsten diarsenide
177841654.description: Tungsten diarsenide is an arsenide of tungsten with the chemical formula WAs2. Other tungsten arsenides include tungsten triarsenide and ditungsten triarsenide .

900000118.name: Agaropectin
900000118.description: Agaropectin is one of the two main components of agar.

900000246.name: Barium carbide
900000246.description: Barium carbide (also referred to as barium ethynediide or barium acetylide) is a chemical compound in the carbide family having the chemical formula BaC2.

900000374.name: Caesium hexafluorocuprate(IV)
900000374.description: Caesium hexafluorocuprate is the inorganic compound with the chemical formula Cs2CuF6.

900000502.name: Convallarin
900000502.description: Convallarin is a crystalline glucoside extracted from the Lily of the Valley plant .

900000630.name: Distarch phosphate
900000630.description: Distarch phosphate, E1412 in the E number scheme of food additives, is a modified starch.

900000886.name: Gatipotuzumab
900000886.description: Gatipotuzumab is a humanized monoclonal antibody recognizing the tumor-specific epitope of mucin-1 , enabling it to differentiate between tumor MUC1 and non-tumor MUC1 epitopes.

900001142.name: Ligelizumab
900001142.description: Ligelizumab is a humanized IgG1 monoclonal antibody designed for the treatment of severe asthma and chronic spontaneous urticaria.

900001270.name: Milbemycin oxime/lufenuron
900001270.description: The combination milbemycin oxime/lufenuron (trade names Sentinel Flavor Tabs, by Novartis Animal Health, and Program plus) is a parasite control drug in which the active ingredient, milbemycin oxime...

900001398.name: Obexelimab
900001398.description: Obexelimab is an experimental drug developed to treat IgG4-related disease and lupus.

900001654.name: Polynoxylin
900001654.description: Polynoxylin is an antiseptic for local treatment of the skin and the mouth. It is a formaldehyde releasing antimicrobial polymer.

900001782.name: Remternetug
900001782.description: Remternetug is an experimental anti-amyloid monoclonal antibody that targets pyroglutamate Aβ. It is developed by Eli Lilly and Company.

900001910.name: Solanezumab
900001910.description: Solanezumab is a monoclonal antibody being investigated by Eli Lilly as a neuroprotector for patients with Alzheimer's disease.

900002166.name: Vusolimogene oderparepvec
900002166.description: Vusolimogene oderparepvec, sold under the brand name Tudriqev, is an anti-cancer medication used for the treatment of melanoma.
